resources.string: Allow typing diacritic keys anywhere in the syllable (e.g. thuongw or thuowng)
Keep \'w\' at word start as \'w\' instead of converting to \'ư\'
Automatically recognize English context to prevent unintended tone marks and restore previous words
Suggest correct words on the suggestion bar when adjacent keys are mistyped
Automatically revert to original keystrokes for English words or invalid syllables upon word completion
Prevent Telex accent composition while typing if it produces an invalid Vietnamese syllable
Allow deleting or tapping into a completed word to adjust or re-apply diacritics
